name: Normal
description: Each crystal rolls one random job belonging exclusively to its own pool.

name: Typhoon
description: Favors earlier jobs by leaving prior pools open as later crystals are unlocked.

name: Volcano
description: Favors later jobs by working backward through the crystal pools.

name: Meteor
description: Completely randomizes the pools. Any crystal can roll any job pool completely out of order.

name: Geyser
description: Favors Water and Earth jobs by mixing in the Wind pool early and the Fire pool late.

name: Sirocco
description: Favors Wind and Fire jobs by mixing in the Water pool early and the Earth pool late.

name: Onsen
description: Leans heavily toward Water and Fire jobs.

name: Haboob
description: Leans heavily toward Wind and Earth jobs.

name: Onion
description: Draws each job slot from a fixed pool of jobs that originally appeared in Final Fantasy 3. Can only be used with Regular (Normal) runs.

name: Classic
description: Players will only be assigned jobs that were in the original Final Fantasy. Classic runs are always Natural runs, meaning the character can only use their assigned job. Forces allow duplicates, and does not allow picking a job set.
